findings.issue: Visual verification covered only 2 of 9 reference pages (home, pokemon-mobile); move/ability/type/not-found/filtered layouts were never compared against design screenshots even though the spec demands close visual match
findings.suggestion: Screenshot each of the nine reference URLs at mobile and desktop widths and diff against design/screenshots/

findings.issue: TypeScript is used throughout but no typecheck was ever run; esbuild strips types silently so type errors would never surface
findings.suggestion: Run tsc --noEmit (or react-router typegen + tsc) at least once before declaring done

findings.issue: pkill -f 'react-router-serve' matched the agent's own bash process and killed it (exit 143), wasting two recovery turns
findings.suggestion: Kill by recorded PID from /tmp/app.pid only, and avoid pkill -f patterns that match the invoking shell

findings.issue: app.css was referenced from root.tsx at turn 31 but never written until the first build failed on UNRESOLVED_IMPORT
findings.suggestion: Write all referenced files before the first build, or build earlier and incrementally

findings.issue: home.tsx was first written with redundant filter logic (normalizedSearch called twice, odd pageHref) and immediately rewritten
findings.suggestion: Sketch the filter/pagination logic before writing the component

findings.issue: Stray tool calls: a pointless bash command and a malformed write invocation missing content
findings.suggestion: Slow down on tool argument construction; these were pure waste

summary: An unusually disciplined session: exhaustive up-front reading and data pre-verification against the tests meant only one test failure in 64 turns, and that one was fixed at the root cause with a minimal edit and re-verified with the full suite plus a live screenshot comparison. Waste was limited to ~6 turns of tool-hygiene slips (typos, a malformed write, a self-killed shell). The main gaps are shallow visual coverage (2 of 9 pages) and never typechecking the TypeScript it wrote.
